Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Objective 2 Game Turn (3 Phases) 2.1 Phase 1: Reveal and Collect 2.2 Phase 2: Place Collected Cards 2.3 Phase 3: Enchant / Capture / Compensate 3 End of Game 4 Scoring 5 Tiebreaker 6 Advanced Mode 6.1 Protection Tokens 6.2 Spirit Summoning (Once per Enchanted Spirit) Objective Win by scoring the most energy points or by enchanting all 6 Nian Shou cards for an instant victory. Game Turn (3 Phases) Phase 1: Reveal and Collect Reveal cards one by one from the draw pile. If all are different Spirits: keep going or stop and take all. If a duplicate is revealed: stop and take only the last card. If first 2 cards are duplicates: gain a Nian Shou card. Use Lotus tokens to take extra revealed cards (1 token = 1 card). Phase 2: Place Collected Cards Choose how to place each collected card: • Spirit side up: goes into your play area for patterns. • Capture side up (Yin/Yang): goes on your Stock card (max 4). Phase 3: Enchant / Capture / Compensate Enchant a Spirit by completing a valid 4-card pattern. Capture an opponent’s Spirit using: • Yin card → captures Yang-protected Spirit • Yang card → captures Yin-protected Spirit • Yin + Yang → captures Nian Shou card Captured card goes to your play area; used capture cards are discarded. Opponent gains 1 token from the supply per card lost. End of Game Game ends when: A player enchants 3 Spirits OR the second draw pile runs out OR someone enchants all 6 Nian Shou cards (instant win) Scoring Points from Enchanted Spirit patterns (Completed spirit) Turtle snake (Blue): +6 Vermilion bird (Orange): +6 Double Azure Dragon (Green): +9 Double Metal Tiger (Purple): +9 Yellow Unicorn (Yellow): +12 +1 per Celestial Spirit Face card outside of the complete patterns +1 per Nian Shou card owned +1 per Capture Face card (card that use Yin/Yang capture Yang/Yin protected spirit card etc) +1 per token in their entire own play area Tiebreaker Player with lesser Spirit face-up cards wins (But BGA set more will be winning in tie break) Advanced Mode Protection Tokens Place token on Yin/Yang symbol of a Spirit card. Protects that card from being captured (requires Yin + Yang to take). Token returns to owner if the card is captured. Tokens on enchanted patterns return to common supply. Spirit Summoning (Once per Enchanted Spirit) Place a Lotus token on the center of an Enchanted Spirit to activate its effect: Turtle Snake: Choose 1 of the top 4 cards → add to play area Vermilion Bird: Take a capture card from discard pile Double Azure Dragon: Pick 1 of top 2 cards → add to play area Double Metal Tiger: Take a Nian Shou card (if any left) Yellow Unicorn: Reclaim a Lotus from another Spirit pattern Board Game Arena would like to thank Victoire Fun for making it possible to have this game here. 2372 beyond العربية беларуская мова български език Brezhoneg Català čeština Dansk Deutsch Ελληνικά English Español Eesti keel فارسی Suomi Français Galego עברית Hrvatski Magyar Italiano Bahasa Indonesia 日本語 한국어 Lietuvių Latviešu Bahasa Malaysia Nederlands Norsk Polski Português Română Русский язык Slovenčina Slovenščina Српски Svenska ไทย Türkçe Українська мова Tiếng Việt 中文 (漢) 中文 (汉) Application loading... ... {DISPLAY_IN_OTHER_LANG} {LANG_REDIRECT_CODE} boardgamearena.com Top Help What is Board Game Arena? There's a mechanic to steal cards from an opponent and protect cards. If you happen to draw two of the same color in the first two cards, you get a special black card.
